shortVersion:
The lack in women's research is concerning.
Ovarian cancer, in particular, remains under-researched and hence only diagnosed at late stages.
As the daughter of a patient, a biomedical engineer and a trainee at a global medical imaging company, I want to contribute to this research.
Welcome to my research blog - ATOLL.

facts.v: Ovarian cancer research, ML & AI applications in oncology

Charlotte completed her Bachelor's and Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering at Imperial College London with First Class Honours. Throughout her studies, she focused on computational modeling and machine learning applications. She then worked as an AI Engineer for a medical fintech company before finding her current position as trainee at a medical imaging company.
